captions.story: An ocean 60 miles deep is hiding under the ice of Jupiter's moon Europa. Could alien life exist down there?

story.series: What Lies Beneath Europa's Ocean Ice?
story.summary: This episode explores Jupiter's moon Europa, its 15-mile thick ice shell, and its 60-mile deep global ocean powered by hydrothermal vents. It introduces the main female astronaut character and sets up the search for alien life.

title: What Lies Beneath Europa's Ocean Ice?
